title: @object-ui/auth：createAuthClient 里 3 处同服务器请求不带令牌，逐个判定（接 #37225）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S3c of the seat's L2 on PR #37489 (#37225), record 7187820695; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37225. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: sign-in flows in @object-ui/auth under a bearer-only session · evidence: L2 record 7187820695; os-dev report 7187574466.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：@object-ui/auth 的 createAuthClient 里还有 3 处同服务器请求不带令牌，需要认证这条线逐个判断该不该带。
- 谁受益：纯令牌会话的用户。
- 不做会怎样：这几处请求在纯令牌会话下按匿名处理。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`: 3 same-server calls without the bearer (census at `a46efa8c`, os-dev report 7187574466). Some may run before a session exists and be legitimately cookie/anonymous; measure each and convert or record it with its reason.

## Acceptance

- Each of the 3 calls is converted or recorded in the ratchet with its reason; a pin for each converted call.
